wins: Consistently identified initial open ports and collected banners across the single episode
Maintained stable reward trajectory throughout steps despite failing to complete objective
fails: Failed to achieve mission success (0% success rate) despite 15 mentor calls
Did not transition from reconnaissance to exploitation, leaving key vulnerabilities unexploited
Repeatedly stalled after identifying initial targets, suggesting deficient decision-making policy
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase shows promise, but the agent lacks guided follow-through to identify high-value targets and execute exploitation, resulting in overall mission failure.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Agent stalls after identifying open services and does not execute follow-up exploit or lateral movement actions
Mentor calls triggered repeatedly during exploitation stage due to lack of concrete action plan

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration using targeted nmap scripts and record findings

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP/HTTPS services are present with accessible directories
skill_cards.then_action: Perform directory brute-force with gobuster and log discovered paths

skill_cards.if_condition: When known vulnerable service version is detected
skill_cards.then_action: Cross-reference CVE database, select exploit, and initiate safe proof-of-concept attempt

memory_ops.reason: High accuracy in enumerating SSH services and gathering relevant banners
Consistent discovery of web directories provides actionable leads

next_experiments.title: Enhance Exploitation Policy After Enumeration
next_experiments.description: Implement a follow-up module that prioritizes exploiting enumerated services immediately instead of waiting for mentor prompts; test with highest-severity vulnerabilities first

next_experiments.title: Reduce Mentor Call Dependency
next_experiments.description: Introduce a decision tree that triggers internal reasoning for exploitation steps once reconnaissance confidence exceeds 0.7, reducing reliance on mentor feedback

next_experiments.title: Triage Based on Service Impact
next_experiments.description: Train scoring model to rank discovered services by potential impact and prompt exploitation of the top two entries per episode
